bio: Leslie A. Guerra is a vocalist, recording artist, and music industry professional with more than twenty-five years of experience spanning live performance, recording, artist development, label operations, A&R, marketing, and entertainment management.
name: Leslie Ann Guerra
bioFull:
Her performance credits include touring as a supporting vocalist for reggaeton icons Don Omar (2006–2015) and J Álvarez (2015–2020), appearing before audiences throughout the United States, Latin America, and Europe. She is featured on the live release King of Kings: En Directo, recorded during Don Omar’s King of Kings World Tour and released by Machete Music.

Guerra began her recording career as a member of Las Nenas del Swing, contributing to recordings including Rompe Corazones, Chicle Bomba, Desearía, and Me Faltas Tú. Throughout her touring career, she also performed on productions featuring artists such as Wisin & Yandel, Arcángel, Daddy Yankee, Natti Natasha, and Melina León.

Beyond the stage, Guerra has held leadership and operational roles throughout the entertainment industry. She served as A&R Coordinator at Sony Music Latin, supporting executive A&R operations and artist development initiatives. She also coordinated artist and management operations for Orfanato Music Group and Arrow Management, managed artist logistics for Adam Torres Concerts, and led marketing and public relations initiatives through NV Marketing & Public Relations.

Today, Guerra combines her experience in performance, artist development, operations, marketing, and business strategy through creative and entrepreneurial ventures, including PortfolioID, a professional platform designed to help artists, creators, and professionals showcase their work, accomplishments, and career journeys.

credits.desc: Founder and product architect of two original SaaS platforms built from concept to deployment.
credits.fullDesc:
Conceived, designed, and built two original SaaS platforms from the ground up — PortfolioID, a professional identity and portfolio platform for artists, creators, and multi-career professionals, and IDPressDrop, a press tracking and media relations management platform for publicists and label teams.

Directed all product architecture, feature development, UX decision-making, content strategy, and deployment infrastructure across a full modern stack including JavaScript, Netlify serverless functions, Cloudinary media management, GitHub version control, and Supabase database architecture.

Defined every feature, user flow, and design system — including bilingual (EN/ES) content support, Cloudinary media organization, QR Smart Share, video and music showcase, credit card documentation system, and professional assets management.

Both platforms were built while simultaneously navigating career development, higher education, royalty recovery, and ongoing business operations — demonstrating the same operational discipline, systems thinking, and execution capacity that defines the full arc of this career.
credits.fullDescEs:
Concibió, diseñó y desarrolló dos plataformas SaaS originales desde cero — PortfolioID, una plataforma de identidad profesional y portafolio para artistas, creadores y profesionales multidisciplinarios, e IDPressDrop, una plataforma de seguimiento de prensa y gestión de relaciones con medios para publicistas y equipos de sellos discográficos.

Dirigió toda la arquitectura de producto, desarrollo de funcionalidades, decisiones de experiencia de usuario, estrategia de contenido e infraestructura de despliegue utilizando un stack moderno que incluye JavaScript, funciones serverless de Netlify, gestión de medios con Cloudinary, control de versiones con GitHub y arquitectura de base de datos con Supabase.

Definió cada funcionalidad, flujo de usuario y sistema de diseño — incluyendo soporte de contenido bilingüe (EN/ES), organización de medios en Cloudinary, QR Smart Share, presentación de video y música, sistema de documentación de créditos y gestión de activos profesionales.

Ambas plataformas fueron desarrolladas simultáneamente con el desarrollo de carrera, educación superior, recuperación de regalías y operaciones comerciales en curso.

Working remotely, she managed digital content production, social media strategy, and campaign coordination for a high-volume multi-artist roster. Artists supported include Nicky Jam, Anuel AA, Manuel Turizo, Olga Tañón, Jay Wheeler, Nio García, and Chocquibtown, among others. Her role required balancing creative execution with operational organization to ensure campaigns remained on schedule and aligned with client objectives. Throughout her tenure, Leslie coordinated marketing assets, managed content workflows, tracked campaign deliverables, and supported audience engagement initiatives across digital platforms. She served as a liaison between creative teams, clients, and project stakeholders, helping maintain consistent communication and project momentum. Campaign work generated coverage across Billboard, Rolling Stone, People en Español, Telemundo, Univision, and SiriusXM. Key Responsibilities: • Conceptualized and built NV Marketing’s Instagram presence from the ground up • Produced and managed full digital content campaigns for Nicky Jam, Anuel AA, Manuel Turizo, Olga Tañón, Jay Wheeler, Nio García, and Chocquibtown • Created release rollouts, Billboard chart announcements, press placement graphics, and award campaign content • Managed Premio Lo Nuestro voting campaigns, new music Friday launches, and concert/tour announcements • Organized campaign timelines, deliverables, and marketing asset distribution • Managed content scheduling and social media coordination across platforms • Facilitated communication between project stakeholders, artists, and campaign teams • Ensured operational accuracy across multiple simultaneous projects Career Significance: NV Marketing & Public Relations represented a natural evolution in Leslie’s career, combining her background in artist development, live entertainment, management operations, and label experience with modern digital marketing and brand strategy. View Campaign Portfolio: https://nvmarketingassets.my.canva.site/ Special thanks to the NV Marketing & Public Relations family for the unforgettable learning experience.

credits.fullDesc: Urban Latino Music — A&R & Project Coordinator New York, NY | 2018–2019 Urban Latino Music is an independent Latin music label founded by Adam Torres — Founder and CEO of Urban Latino MGMT Group and Adam Torres Concerts, a concert promotions and marketing company. Torres is a prominent figure in the music industry, known for successful concerts in major venues across the United States and as the former manager of reggaetón icon Don Omar. As A&R & Project Coordinator, Leslie Ann Guerra oversaw artist development and release execution for emerging Latin artist MoMo (Monique González) — a Cuban singer-songwriter described as an ascending force in the Latin music industry, with a perfect combination of talent, dance, and vocal performance. She assisted Torres on the release of the single “Tumba” — a bilingual Latin-pop and dancehall summer anthem featuring internationally acclaimed Jamaican artist Konshens. Produced by Víctor Moore a.k.a. Jumbo, mixed and co-produced by Juan G. Rivera Vázquez (Gaby Music), and mastered by Mike Fuller (Fuller Sound Mastering), released July 26, 2019. “Tumba” obtained placements in important streaming playlists including Spotify New Music Friday Latin, Spotify New Music Friday Norway, Novedades Viernes Argentina, TIDAL Rising: Latin, and La Musica. Given the single’s positive reception, it received coverage in major platforms including Billboard and People en Español. “Tumba” also entered the HTV voting bracket alongside major Latin artists, with additional visibility across Telemundo and Univision. Soon after its release, MoMo attended and presented at the 2019 Latin American Music Awards at the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles, where she was recognized among the best dressed on the red carpet. Simultaneously, she was also advancing her acting career, landing the role of Alysha in BET’s “Tales” Season 2, Episode 5 “Bodak Yellow” — a pivotal moment that coincided with Tumba’s release and expanded her visibility across US mainstream audiences. Responsibilities included overseeing communication across artist, production, and marketing teams, supporting full creative direction and promotional rollout, and coordinating award show representation and logistics. Special thanks to Adam Torres and Monique González for the incredible opportunity. To AJ Ramos for the immense support throughout this campaign, NV Marketing & Public Relations, and The Artistry Records.
credits.fullDescEs: Urban Latino Music — Coordinadora de A&R y Proyectos Nueva York, NY | 2018–2019 Urban Latino Music es un sello de música latina independiente fundado por Adam Torres — Fundador y CEO de Urban Latino MGMT Group y Adam Torres Concerts, una empresa de promoción y mercadeo de conciertos. Torres es una figura prominente en la industria musical, conocido por conciertos exitosos en importantes venues de los Estados Unidos y como ex mánager del icono del reggaetón Don Omar. Como Coordinadora de A&R y Proyectos, Leslie Ann Guerra supervisó el desarrollo artístico y la ejecución de lanzamientos para la emergente artista latina MoMo (Monique González) — una cantautora cubana descrita como una fuerza ascendente en la industria musical latina. Asistió a Torres en el lanzamiento del sencillo “Tumba” — un anthem bilingüe de Latin-pop y dancehall veraniego con la participación del internacionalmente aclamado artista jamaicano Konshens. Producido por Víctor Moore a.k.a. Jumbo, mezclado y co-producido por Juan G. Rivera Vázquez (Gaby Music), y masterizado por Mike Fuller (Fuller Sound Mastering), lanzado el 26 de julio de 2019. “Tumba” obtuvo colocaciones en importantes playlists de streaming incluyendo Spotify New Music Friday Latin, Spotify New Music Friday Norway, Novedades Viernes Argentina, TIDAL Rising: Latin y La Musica. Dada la positiva recepción del sencillo, recibió cobertura en importantes plataformas incluyendo Billboard y People en Español, además de entrar en el bracket de votación de HTV junto a importantes artistas latinos, con visibilidad adicional en Telemundo y Univision. Poco después de su lanzamiento, MoMo asistió y presentó en los Latin American Music Awards 2019 en el Dolby Theatre de Los Ángeles, donde fue reconocida entre las mejor vestidas de la alfombra roja. Simultáneamente, también avanzaba en su carrera actoral, obteniendo el papel de Alysha en “Tales” de BET, Temporada 2, Episodio 5 “Bodak Yellow”. Un agradecimiento especial a Adam Torres y Monique González por la increíble oportunidad. A AJ Ramos por el inmenso apoyo durante esta campaña, a NV Marketing & Public Relations y a The Artistry Records.

credits.fullDesc: Adam Torres Concerts — Artist Logistics Coordinator New York, NY | 2017–2020 Adam Torres Concerts, founded by industry veteran Adam Torres, CEO of Urban Latino MGMT Group, is a New York-based concert promotion company known for producing large-scale live entertainment events at premier venues including Barclays Center, Radio City Music Hall, and the Apollo Theater. Reporting to Director of Event Logistics Jeanette Rivera, Leslie A. Guerra served as a key liaison between artists, management teams, transportation personnel, and production staff, helping ensure smooth artist movement and communication throughout all phases of live event execution. Working closely with Adam Torres, Jeanette Rivera, Head of Transportation Larry Quito, and Production Manager Vince Galis-Menendez, Leslie was brought in for concert productions to oversee artist logistics from arrival through departure. Her role focused on coordinating artist movement, maintaining communication between departments, and ensuring artists received timely support throughout each event. Key Responsibilities: • Coordinated artist arrival and departure logistics for live event productions • Maintained communication with artist management teams regarding schedules, call times, and event-day logistics • Coordinated transportation schedules with the event transportation department • Monitored artist arrivals at airports, hotels, venues, and performance locations • Escorted artists to designated backstage and dressing-room areas when required • Communicated artist status updates to production and event operations personnel • Coordinated movement between dressing rooms, backstage areas, and performance stages • Assisted with venue-to-hotel departures and end-of-event logistics • Helped ensure accurate artist accountability and operational readiness throughout event execution • Supported communication between artists, management, transportation, and production teams in fast-paced live-event environments Notable Productions: Supported events at premier venues including Barclays Center, Radio City Music Hall, and the Apollo Theater, working with productions featuring artists such as Bad Bunny, J Balvin, Luis Fonsi, Snoop Dogg, DMX, Cardi B, Maxwell, Ozuna, Farruko, Willie Colón, India, and other leading performers across Latin, Hip-Hop, R&B, and classic urban music genres. Career Significance: This role expanded Leslie’s expertise in artist services, concert operations, transportation logistics, stakeholder coordination, and large-scale event execution. It provided firsthand experience supporting major concert productions and reinforced the operational skills that later complemented her work in artist management, A&R, marketing, and entertainment business operations. Special thanks to the entire ATS team for entrusting me with such a trusted position, for your professionalism, and for a priceless experience. Grateful beyond words.

credits.fullDesc: Arrow Management — Artist Operations & Management Coordinator Garfield, New Jersey | 2013–2015 Following years of experience in live performance and touring, Leslie A. In this role, Leslie supported the day-to-day operational and administrative functions associated with artist management, business affairs, and entertainment operations. Working closely with management personnel, artists, vendors, and business partners, she helped coordinate internal processes essential to the successful execution of artist-related activities and organizational objectives. Her responsibilities included managing schedules, coordinating communications, organizing documentation, supporting logistical planning, and assisting with operational workflows across multiple projects. The position required exceptional organization, discretion, adaptability, and the ability to manage competing priorities within a fast-paced entertainment environment. This experience provided Leslie with valuable exposure to the business and operational side of the music industry, expanding her expertise beyond performance and touring into artist management, administration, organizational leadership, and entertainment business operations. Key Responsibilities: • Coordinated artist management and operational support activities • Managed calendars, scheduling, and administrative workflows • Facilitated communication between management, artists, vendors, and business partners • Organized operational records, documentation, and internal processes • Supported logistical planning and project coordination • Assisted with day-to-day business operations and management initiatives • Maintained confidential information and sensitive documentation • Tracked priorities, deadlines, and organizational deliverables • Supported multiple concurrent projects within a high-volume environment • Contributed to efficient execution of artist-related business activities Career Significance: Arrow Management marked Leslie’s transition from primarily performing on stage to understanding the operational infrastructure that supports successful artists and entertainment brands. The experience provided a foundation in artist management, business administration, and organizational operations that would later support her work in A&R, marketing, artist development, and executive coordination roles throughout the music industry. Special thanks to William Omar Landrón Rivera, Héctor Luis Landrón Rivera, Rebeca López, and Milton Johan Restituyo for the life-altering experience I will never, ever forget.

credits.fullDesc: Las Nenas del Swing — Recording Artist / Founding Member Before Las Nenas del Swing was formed, Leslie A. Guerra was already establishing herself as a performer throughout Puerto Rico, appearing at venues including Hotel Intercontinental and Hotel San Juan. It was during a Sunday performance at Rancho de los Trovadores in Cayey that Elvis Crespo and Wilfredo Ortiz walked in — and everything changed. That night led to an audition with producer Luis Corporán and her selection as a founding member of Las Nenas del Swing. On September 10, 1998, Las Nenas del Swing released Rompe Corazones, an 11-track tropical and merengue album released through R&R Music, distributed in Puerto Rico by Combo Records and in the United States through Rimas Records in New York. Managed by Ramón Rivera, who also managed Grupo Karis, the group developed a growing fan base throughout Puerto Rico, the Caribbean, and major East Coast Latino markets. As a founding member and featured vocalist, Leslie contributed to several of the album’s best-known recordings, including Chicle Bomba, Desearía, and Me Faltas Tú. The project featured contributions from respected musicians and vocalists within the tropical music genre, including backing vocal participation by Elvis Crespo, Juan Castro (Tony Tun Tun), and Juan Luis Guzmán. Production credits included Freddy Méndez on piano and Luis Corporán on saxophone. During the promotional cycle for Rompe Corazones, Las Nenas del Swing shared stages with prominent tropical and merengue acts including Los Hermanos Rosario, El Gran Combo de Puerto Rico, Grupo Karis, Grupo Manía, Grupo Mambo, Manny Manuel, Tony Tun Tun, Melina León, and Gisselle. The group also participated in performances associated with the New York Puerto Rican Day Parade and appeared throughout Puerto Rico, Connecticut, Pennsylvania, Massachusetts, and the Dominican Republic. Rompe Corazones represents Leslie Guerra’s earliest documented commercial recording credit and the beginning of a professional music career that would later expand into international touring, artist development, label operations, marketing, A&R, and entertainment management. Today, the album remains available through major digital streaming platforms, preserving an important chapter in Puerto Rican tropical music and serving as the foundation of Leslie’s decades-long career in the music industry. Special thanks to Melissa, Marie, and Kadmara — and to Elvis Crespo, Wilfredo Ortiz, Ramón Rivera, Luis Corporán, Freddie Méndez, and Raúl Armando Del Valle for their guidance, support, and belief during the formative years of this journey.
credits.fullDescEs: Las Nenas del Swing — Artista de Grabación / Miembro Fundadora Antes de que Las Nenas del Swing se formara, Leslie A. Guerra ya se estaba estableciendo como artista en Puerto Rico, presentándose en venues como el Hotel Intercontinental y el Hotel San Juan. Fue durante una actuación dominical en el Rancho de los Trovadores en Cayey que Elvis Crespo y Wilfredo Ortiz entraron al lugar — y todo cambió. Esa noche llevó a una audición con el productor Luis Corporán y a su selección como miembro fundadora de Las Nenas del Swing. El 10 de septiembre de 1998, Las Nenas del Swing lanzaron Rompe Corazones, un álbum de 11 pistas de tropical y merengue bajo R&R Music, distribuido en Puerto Rico por Combo Records y en Estados Unidos por Rimas Records en Nueva York. Bajo la gestión de Ramón Rivera, quien también representaba a Grupo Karis, el grupo desarrolló una creciente base de seguidores en Puerto Rico, el Caribe y los principales mercados latinos de la Costa Este. Como miembro fundadora y vocalista destacada, Leslie contribuyó a algunas de las grabaciones más reconocidas del álbum, incluyendo Chicle Bomba, Desearía y Me Faltas Tú. El proyecto contó con la participación de reconocidos músicos y vocalistas del género tropical, incluyendo coros de Elvis Crespo, Juan Castro (Tony Tun Tun) y Juan Luis Guzmán. Los créditos de producción incluyen a Freddy Méndez en piano y Luis Corporán en saxofón. Durante el ciclo promocional de Rompe Corazones, Las Nenas del Swing compartieron escenarios con destacadas figuras del tropical y el merengue, incluyendo a Los Hermanos Rosario, El Gran Combo de Puerto Rico, Grupo Karis, Grupo Manía, Grupo Mambo, Manny Manuel, Tony Tun Tun, Melina León y Gisselle. El grupo también participó en presentaciones asociadas al Desfile Puertorriqueño de Nueva York y se presentó en Puerto Rico, Connecticut, Pensilvania, Massachusetts y la República Dominicana. Rompe Corazones representa el primer crédito comercial de grabación documentado de Leslie Guerra y el inicio de una carrera musical profesional que se expandiría hacia giras internacionales, desarrollo artístico, operaciones discográficas, mercadeo, A&R y gestión del entretenimiento. Hoy, el álbum sigue disponible en las principales plataformas digitales de streaming, preservando un capítulo importante de la música tropical puertorriqueña y sirviendo como la base de la carrera de Leslie en la industria musical. Un agradecimiento especial a mis compañeras Melissa, Marie y Kadmara — y a Elvis Crespo, Wilfredo Ortiz, Ramón Rivera, Luis Corporán, Freddie Méndez y Raúl Armando Del Valle por su guía, apoyo y confianza durante los años formativos de este camino.

credits.fullDesc: Leslie served as the exclusive touring female vocalist for Don Omar across multiple international productions and live tours spanning nearly a decade. Her live performance work appears on King of Kings: En Directo, released through Machete Music in 2007 — a large-scale live production distributed internationally in CD and DVD formats and broadcast through DirecTV. Throughout her touring career with Don Omar, Leslie participated in hundreds of performances across five continents, including appearances at Madison Square Garden, Radio City Music Hall, Luna Park Stadium, Viña del Mar International Song Festival, Coliseo de Puerto Rico José Miguel Agrelot, and Kaseya Center, along with televised appearances and international broadcast productions. Her introduction into reggaetón touring began during the genre’s early commercial expansion after being recruited by musical director Félix Márquez for live performances with Héctor & Tito. Prior to joining Don Omar’s touring productions, she also performed as a backup vocalist for Melina León. Approximately one year later, she was invited by sound engineer Ramón Pabón to join Don Omar’s first major live touring production, eventually becoming one of the few prominently featured female touring vocalists within large-scale international reggaetón productions during the genre’s global crossover era. Special thanks to William Omar Landrón for the opportunity of a lifetime — and for that midnight call that changed everything. To Ramón Pabón and Carlos Martínez, sound engineers for Don Omar and former engineers for Melina León, whose referral opened the door. It was Ramón who made the call that night, with Don on the line, and nothing was ever the same after that. To Adam Torres, Abraham Quiñones, and Miguel Márquez for their support and unwavering presence throughout this journey. And to fellow colleagues Ángel Eric Ríos, Mario VI, DJ Robin, and DJ Eliel — the team behind the scenes that made every show feel like family coming home.
credits.fullDescEs: Leslie se desempeñó como vocalista femenina exclusiva de gira para Don Omar en múltiples producciones y giras internacionales durante casi una década. Su trabajo en vivo forma parte de King of Kings: En Directo, lanzado por Machete Music en 2007, una producción en vivo distribuida internacionalmente en formatos CD y DVD y transmitida a través de DirecTV. A lo largo de su carrera de giras con Don Omar, Leslie participó en cientos de presentaciones en cinco continentes, incluyendo el Madison Square Garden, Radio City Music Hall, Luna Park Stadium, el Festival Internacional de la Canción de Viña del Mar, el Coliseo de Puerto Rico José Miguel Agrelot y el Kaseya Center, además de apariciones televisadas y producciones de transmisión internacional. Su entrada al mundo de las giras de reggaetón comenzó durante la expansión comercial temprana del género, cuando fue reclutada por el director musical Félix Márquez para presentaciones en vivo con Héctor & Tito. Antes de unirse a las producciones de gira de Don Omar, también se desempeñó como vocalista de apoyo para Melina León. Aproximadamente un año después, fue invitada por el ingeniero de sonido Ramón Pabón a integrarse a la primera gran producción de gira en vivo de Don Omar. Un agradecimiento especial a William Omar Landrón por la oportunidad de una vida — y por esa llamada a medianoche que lo cambió todo. A Ramón Pabón y Carlos Martínez, ingenieros de sonido de Don Omar y ex ingenieros de Melina León, cuya recomendación abrió la puerta. Fue Ramón quien hizo esa llamada aquella noche, con Don al teléfono, y nada volvió a ser igual después de eso. A Adam Torres, Abraham Quiñones y Miguel Márquez por su apoyo y presencia a lo largo de este camino. Y a los colegas Ángel Eric Ríos, Mario VI, DJ Robin y DJ Eliel — el equipo detrás del escenario que hizo que cada show se sintiera como volver a casa en familia.

credits.fullDesc: Melina León — Touring Vocalist / Live Performance Artist 2000–2006 Following her recording debut as a founding member of Las Nenas del Swing, Leslie A. Guerra continued building her career within Puerto Rico’s tropical music scene, joining the touring and performance team of renowned Puerto Rican singer Melina León. From 2000 through 2006, Leslie served as a supporting vocalist, an opportunity that significantly expanded her professional touring experience and allowed her to perform regularly before large audiences throughout Puerto Rico and beyond. As a member of Melina León’s live performance team, Leslie participated in concerts, festivals, television appearances, promotional events, and special productions — contributing background vocals, vocal harmonies, stage performance support, rehearsals, and live production execution. These experiences refined the skills and professionalism required to succeed in large-scale touring environments. Six years alongside Melina León provided invaluable experience in professional touring, artist support, stagecraft, production coordination, and live entertainment operations. The relationships and industry knowledge gained during this chapter became a critical bridge between her early recording career and the international touring opportunities that would follow — ultimately leading to her selection as a touring vocalist for Don Omar. Key Contributions: • Touring and Supporting Vocalist (2000–2006) • Concerts, festivals, promotional events, television appearances, and live productions throughout Puerto Rico • Harmony vocals and live performance support • Developed the professional foundation that led to international touring with Don Omar Special thanks to Yamillette Aponte Yunqué (Melina León) for the opportunity and for the years of unforgettable stages shared together. To Félix “Felito El Ronko” Márquez, whose invitation opened this door. And to José Hiram Villanueva — for pushing me to walk through it. To every musician and colleague who shared those stages — thank you for making it feel like family.
credits.fullDescEs: Melina León — Vocalista de Gira / Artista de Presentaciones en Vivo 2000–2006 Tras su debut discográfico como miembro fundadora de Las Nenas del Swing, Leslie A. Guerra continuó construyendo su carrera dentro de la escena de la música tropical de Puerto Rico, uniéndose al equipo de giras y presentaciones de la reconocida cantante puertorriqueña Melina León. Desde el año 2000 hasta 2006, Leslie se desempeñó como vocalista de apoyo, una oportunidad que expandió significativamente su experiencia en giras profesionales y le permitió presentarse regularmente ante grandes audiencias en Puerto Rico y más allá. Como parte del equipo de presentaciones en vivo de Melina León, Leslie participó en conciertos, festivales, apariciones televisivas, eventos promocionales y producciones especiales — aportando voces de fondo, armonías vocales, soporte escénico, ensayos y ejecución de producción en vivo. Estas experiencias refinaron las habilidades y el profesionalismo necesarios para triunfar en entornos de gira a gran escala. Seis años junto a Melina León brindaron una experiencia invaluable en giras profesionales, apoyo artístico, técnicas escénicas, coordinación de producción y operaciones de entretenimiento en vivo. Las relaciones y el conocimiento de la industria adquiridos durante este capítulo se convirtieron en un puente fundamental entre su temprana carrera discográfica y las oportunidades de gira internacional que vendrían — lo que finalmente llevó a su selección como vocalista de gira para Don Omar. Contribuciones Principales: • Vocalista de Gira y de Apoyo (2000–2006) • Conciertos, festivales, eventos promocionales, apariciones televisivas y producciones en vivo en todo Puerto Rico • Armonías vocales y soporte en presentaciones en vivo • Desarrolló la base profesional que llevó a giras internacionales con Don Omar Un agradecimiento especial a Yamillette Aponte Yunqué (Melina León) por la oportunidad y por los años de escenarios inolvidables compartidos. A Félix “Felito El Ronko” Márquez, cuya invitación abrió esta puerta. Y a José Hiram Villanueva — por impulsarme a cruzarla. A cada músico y colega que compartió esos escenarios — gracias por hacer que todo se sintiera como familia.

credits.desc: Federal Emergency Management Agency | Trujillo Alto, PR | 2001–2006. Bilingual Human Services Specialist. Progressed from frontline bilingual customer support to case management. Promoted based on performance and accuracy.
credits.descEs: Agencia Federal para el Manejo de Emergencias | Trujillo Alto, PR | 2001–2006. Especialista bilingüe en Servicios Humanos. Progresó desde soporte al cliente en primera línea hasta gestión de casos.
credits.fullDesc: FEMA — Human Services Specialist (GS-9) Federal Emergency Management Agency | Trujillo Alto, Puerto Rico | 2001–2006 Joined FEMA as a Bilingual Customer Service Agent, providing English and Spanish language support to disaster-affected applicants navigating the federal assistance process. Progressed to Translation Specialist, then advanced to Case Worker — responsible for reviewing, evaluating, and adjudicating federal disaster assistance applications in accordance with federal compliance standards. As Case Worker, determined applicant eligibility for federal disaster relief, maintained detailed and accurate case documentation, and managed a high-volume caseload across sustained disaster response operations. Work required strict adherence to federal guidelines, careful attention to documentation integrity, and consistent professionalism when working with applicants in vulnerable circumstances. In addition to processing federal assistance applications, Leslie connected disaster victims with a broader network of recovery resources — including U.S. Small Business Administration (SBA) disaster loans for homeowners and businesses, American Red Cross shelter and emergency services, Salvation Army relief programs, HUD housing assistance, and USDA food and nutrition support programs. This comprehensive service approach ensured that applicants received guidance beyond FEMA’s direct assistance programs and were connected to every available resource for their recovery. This role established the foundation for a professional discipline in compliance, case management, federal documentation standards, and bilingual public service that carried through subsequent career positions. It was an honor and a privilege to have served during two of the most impactful disasters in modern American history — September 11, 2001 and Hurricane Katrina August 29, 2005. Bearing witness to the resilience of those affected deepened my empathy, my sense of purpose, and my appreciation for the life I had been given. Serving others in their most vulnerable moments changed me profoundly. To my FEMA family — the M.F.O. Crew — you were never just colleagues. You were community. You still hold a special place in my heart, and you always will. Thank you.
credits.fullDescEs: FEMA — Especialista en Servicios Humanos (GS-9) Agencia Federal para el Manejo de Emergencias | Trujillo Alto, Puerto Rico | 2001–2006 Se incorporó a FEMA como Agente de Servicio al Cliente Bilingüe, brindando apoyo en inglés y español a solicitantes afectados por desastres que navegaban el proceso de asistencia federal. Avanzó a Especialista en Traducción y luego a Trabajadora de Casos — responsable de revisar, evaluar y adjudicar solicitudes de asistencia federal por desastre conforme a los estándares de cumplimiento federal. Como Trabajadora de Casos, determinó la elegibilidad de solicitantes para asistencia federal por desastre, mantuvo documentación de casos detallada y precisa, y gestionó una carga de trabajo de alto volumen durante operaciones de respuesta sostenida a desastres. Además de procesar solicitudes de asistencia federal, Leslie conectaba a las víctimas de desastres con una red más amplia de recursos de recuperación — incluyendo préstamos por desastre de la Administración de Pequeños Negocios (SBA), servicios de refugio y emergencia de la Cruz Roja Americana, programas de alivio del Ejército de Salvación, asistencia de vivienda de HUD y programas de asistencia alimentaria del USDA. Este rol estableció la base para una disciplina profesional en cumplimiento, manejo de casos, estándares de documentación federal y servicio público bilingüe que se mantuvo a lo largo de su carrera. Fue un honor y un privilegio haber servido durante dos de los desastres más impactantes de la historia moderna de los Estados Unidos — el 11 de septiembre de 2001 y el Huracán Katrina el 29 de agosto de 2005. Ser testigo de la resiliencia de quienes fueron afectados profundizó mi empatía, mi sentido de propósito y mi gratitud por la vida que me había sido dada. Servir a otros en sus momentos más vulnerables me transformó profundamente. A mi familia de FEMA — el M.F.O. Crew — nunca fueron solo colegas. Fueron comunidad. Todavía ocupan un lugar muy especial en mi corazón, y siempre lo harán. Gracias.

credits.fullDesc: Venetian Productions (KLMA) — Head of Compliance Doral, FL | 2006–2013 Leslie joined Venetian Productions having been recruited for a coordinator position — and was immediately placed as Web Producer instead. From day one she managed 7 concurrent website productions working alongside 3 directors. Within six months that grew to 18 simultaneous productions with 8 directors. As Web Producer, she managed the full production lifecycle independently across all projects — overseeing creative direction, set design, scripting, talent selection, location coordination, props, wardrobe, transportation, and production support from pre-production through final delivery. She was then offered and accepted the role of Head of Compliance, leading compliance-focused operational support across administrative, legal documentation, and internal coordination functions, managing a staff of 4 with additional support brought in for large-scale productions. The role required exceptional accuracy, confidentiality, procedural consistency, and operational oversight — ensuring all internal workflows aligned with business requirements and compliance standards. Key Responsibilities: • Oversaw compliance documentation and administrative record management • Maintained legal and operational filing systems with strict accuracy standards • Coordinated contract-related documentation and internal processing workflows • Managed confidential records and sensitive operational information • Built and structured the customer service department from the ground up • Supervised compliance staff across standard and large-scale productions • Ensured adherence to company policies and procedural requirements • Maintained precision across high-volume administrative priorities Special thanks to Carol Santiago (now Carol Crews) and Olivier Caudron for the various opportunities extended — from Head Producer to Head of Compliance. This chapter of my career shaped a discipline and a standard I carry to this day.
credits.fullDescEs: Venetian Productions (KLMA) — Jefa de Cumplimiento Doral, FL | 2006–2013 Leslie se unió a Venetian Productions habiendo sido reclutada para una posición de coordinadora — y fue colocada de inmediato como Productora Web. Desde el primer día gestionó 7 producciones web simultáneas trabajando junto a 3 directores. En seis meses eso creció a 18 producciones simultáneas con 8 directores. Como Productora Web, gestionó de forma independiente el ciclo completo de producción en todos los proyectos — supervisando dirección creativa, diseño de sets, guión, selección de talento, coordinación de locaciones, utilería, vestuario, transporte y apoyo de producción desde la preproducción hasta la entrega final. Posteriormente fue invitada a asumir el rol de Jefa de Cumplimiento, liderando el apoyo operacional enfocado en cumplimiento a través de funciones administrativas, documentación legal y coordinación interna, gestionando un equipo de 4 empleados con apoyo adicional en producciones de gran escala. El rol requirió precisión excepcional, confidencialidad, consistencia procedimental y supervisión operativa — asegurando que todos los flujos de trabajo internos estuvieran alineados con los requisitos empresariales y los estándares de cumplimiento. Responsabilidades Principales: • Supervisió documentación de cumplimiento y gestión de registros administrativos • Mantuvo sistemas de archivo legal y operacional con estrictos estándares de precisión • Coordinó documentación contractual y flujos de procesamiento interno • Gestionó registros confidenciales e información operacional sensible • Construyó y estructuró el departamento de servicio al cliente desde cero • Supervisó personal de cumplimiento en producciones estándar y a gran escala • Garantizó el cumplimiento de políticas y requisitos de la empresa • Mantuvo precisión en prioridades administrativas de alto volumen Un agradecimiento especial a Carol Santiago (ahora Carol Crews) y Olivier Caudron por las múltiples oportunidades extendidas — desde Productora Principal hasta Jefa de Cumplimiento. Este capítulo de mi carrera forjó una disciplina y un estándar que llevo conmigo hasta el día de hoy.

credits.fullDesc: A&R Coordinator | Artist & Label Operations Sony Music Latin | Coconut Grove, FL | 2017–2018 Leslie Guerra served as A&R Coordinator at Sony Music Latin under Luis Alejandro Gallardo González — then Senior Vice President of A&R, now President of Sony Music US Latin — supporting one of the most prolific Latin music rosters in the industry. In this role, Leslie operated as an operational anchor across A&R, marketing, production, legal, finance, and creative teams — managing executive and artist travel, studio logistics, vendor relationships, purchase orders, budgeting, and invoice processing. She supported release preparation and major campaign coordination, working directly at the intersection of executive strategy and day-to-day label operations. This experience gave Leslie an insider view of how world-class Latin music is built — from the earliest A&R decisions to release execution — and established the cross-functional fluency she brings to every project today. Special thanks to Sony Music Latin, Alex Gallardo, Daniel Restrepo, and Isabel de Jesús for the opportunity and the invaluable experience within one of the most respected labels in the Latin music industry.
credits.fullDescEs: Coordinadora de A&R | Operaciones Artísticas y de Sello Sony Music Latin | Coconut Grove, FL | 2017–2018 Leslie Guerra se desempeñó como Coordinadora de A&R en Sony Music Latin bajo la dirección de Luis Alejandro Gallardo González — entonces Senior Vice President de A&R y hoy Presidente de Sony Music US Latin — brindando soporte a uno de los catálogos de música latina más prolíficos de la industria. En este rol, Leslie funcionó como eje operativo entre los departamentos de A&R, mercadeo, producción, legal, finanzas y equipos creativos — gestionando viajes ejecutivos y de artistas, logística de estudios, relaciones con proveedores, órdenes de compra, presupuestos y procesamiento de facturas. Participó activamente en la preparación de lanzamientos y la coordinación de campañas de alto perfil, operando en el punto de encuentro entre la estrategia ejecutiva y las operaciones diarias de la disquera. Esta experiencia le permitió a Leslie entender desde adentro cómo se construye la música latina de clase mundial — desde las primeras decisiones de A&R hasta la ejecución del lanzamiento — y es la base de la versatilidad que hoy lleva a cada proyecto. Un agradecimiento especial a Sony Music Latin, Alex Gallardo, Daniel Restrepo e Isabel de Jesús por la oportunidad y la invaluable experiencia dentro de uno de los sellos más respetados de la industria musical latina.

shortBio: Leslie A. Guerra is a vocalist, recording artist, and music industry professional with more than twenty-five years of experience spanning live performance, recording, artist development, label operations, A&R, marketing, and entertainment management.
bioFullES:
Sus créditos artísticos incluyen giras como vocalista de apoyo junto a los íconos del reggaetón Don Omar (2006–2015) y J Álvarez (2015–2020), presentándose ante audiencias en Estados Unidos, América Latina y Europa. También aparece en el lanzamiento en vivo King of Kings: En Directo, grabado durante la gira mundial King of Kings World Tour de Don Omar y publicado por Machete Music.

Guerra inició su carrera discográfica como integrante de Las Nenas del Swing, participando en producciones y grabaciones como Rompe Corazones, Chicle Bomba, Desearía y Me Faltas Tú. A lo largo de su trayectoria en giras y espectáculos, también participó en producciones que incluyeron artistas como Wisin & Yandel, Arcángel, Daddy Yankee, Natti Natasha y Melina León.

Más allá de los escenarios, Guerra ha ocupado posiciones de liderazgo, coordinación y operaciones dentro de la industria del entretenimiento. Se desempeñó como Coordinadora de A&R en Sony Music Latin, brindando apoyo a operaciones ejecutivas de A&R e iniciativas de desarrollo artístico. También coordinó operaciones artísticas y de manejo para Orfanato Music Group y Arrow Management, gestionó logística artística para Adam Torres Concerts y lideró iniciativas de mercadeo y relaciones públicas a través de NV Marketing & Public Relations.

Actualmente, Guerra combina su experiencia en interpretación, desarrollo artístico, operaciones, mercadeo y estrategia empresarial a través de proyectos creativos y empresariales, incluyendo PortfolioID, una plataforma profesional diseñada para ayudar a artistas, creadores y profesionales a presentar su trayectoria, logros y portafolio de manera moderna y organizada.
